evals.prompt: Audit http://localhost:8080/ against WCAG 3.0 and tell me what fails. There's a dev server running on port 8080.
evals.expected_output: A structured audit report citing WCAG 3.0 requirement names with WCAG 2.2 mappings, evidence (selectors/pages), Core vs Supplemental classification, a manual-review section, and no false conformance claims. Report comes before any fixes.

evals.prompt: My blog needs an accessibility check before I show it to people. It's running at http://localhost:8080/ and the source is at C:\Users\erikc\OneDrive\Desktop\blog. Audit it against WCAG and fix what you find.
evals.expected_output: Both rendered-page audit (headless browser + axe) and source-level checks (reduced-motion, focus styles, viewport meta, templates emitting alt-less imgs). A prioritized report first; fixes applied only after asking for approval; re-verification diff after fixes.

evals.prompt: A low-vision reader emailed saying they can't read the text on my site at http://localhost:8080/ and tabbing around the homepage is confusing. Check what WCAG says about that and what I need to change.
evals.expected_output: Focused pass on contrast (2.2.1 / SC 1.4.3) and focus indicators + heading/focus order (2.3.1, 2.3.3 / SC 2.4.11, 2.4.3) with measured contrast ratios and specific CSS fixes proposed, referencing WCAG 3 requirements and 2.2 SCs.
